# dremio_user (Resource)

Profile of an existing local Dremio Community Edition user. Import by UUID is required; creation, deletion, passwords and permissions are deliberately outside this resource's scope. Enterprise and externally provisioned users are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Existing local users must be imported by UUID. Passwords and permissions
# remain under their existing identity-management workflow.
resource "dremio_user" "existing" {
  name = "existing-user"

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

import {
  to = dremio_user.existing
  id = "b9dbebc7-bc3b-4d56-9154-31762ab65a43"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Existing username. Renaming users is not supported.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email; omitted values retain the existing profile.
- `first_name` (String) First name; omitted values retain the existing profile.
- `last_name` (String) Last name; omitted values retain the existing profile.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Current account status; never changed by this resource.
- `id` (String) Stable user UUID.
- `tag` (String) Version used for optimistic concurrency.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import dremio_user.existing b9dbebc7-bc3b-4d56-9154-31762ab65a43
```
